period_note: Balance sheet is the 31-Mar-2024 period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis. Income statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (Q1 = 3 months, so cumulative and discrete are identical this quarter). Source PDF text layer is present but has scattered OCR-style corruption typical of this bank's 2021-2024 filings; every figure below was cross-checked against (a) this filing's own 31-Dec-2023 comparative column, which matches this dataset's existing 2023_Q4.json EXACTLY for total_assets (317,770.681881m), total_equity (19,242.96641m), total_deposits (240,246.874582m) and paid_up_capital (10,297.79601m), and (b) full internal reconciliation. statutory_reserve for the CURRENT period (31-Mar-2024) was dropped by the OCR between 'Paid-up Capital' and 'Surplus in profit & loss account' on the balance sheet; it is CALCULATED two independent ways that agree exactly: (i) prior year-end 7,443.591894m (2023_Q4.json) + this quarter's own reported statutory-reserve appropriation of 93.44253m = 7,537.034424m; (ii) total_equity(19,545.986405m) - paid_up_capital(10,297.79601m) - surplus-in-P&L(1,471.457348m) - revaluation-reserve(239.698623m) = 7,537.034424m. The appropriation itself (93.44253m) is exactly 20.00% of this quarter's profit-before-tax (467.21265m x 20% = 93.44253m), confirming the bank's 20%-of-PBT statutory-reserve rule. Balance-sheet identity holds exactly (295,271.456205 + 19,545.986405 = 314,817.44261). Income statement fully reconciles: operating_profit = total_operating_income - total_operating_expenses (2,728.384494-1,616.423453=1,111.961041 exact); profit_before_tax = operating_profit - total_provision (1,111.961041-644.74839=467.212651, matches 467.21265 reported); profit_after_tax = profit_before_tax - tax_expense (467.21265-59.267267=407.945383 exact). Deferred tax was a small NET CREDIT this quarter (-0.732733m, i.e. income, not expense) against a current tax expense of 60.0m - contemporaneous EPS is 0.40, notably higher than the 0.38 shown for this same Q1-2024 period as a comparative column in the later FY2025 Q1 filing - a routine EPS restatement for a subsequent bonus share issue (paid-up capital rose from 10,297.79601m at this date to 10,658.21887m by 30-Sep-2024), not a profit restatement; contemporaneous 0.40 is kept per project convention (prefer contemporaneous).
